name: Christian Convery
bio:
Christian Convery (born November 10, 2009) is a Canadian and American child actor. He is best known for his leading role as Gus in the Netflix series Sweet Tooth (2021–2024) and his performance in the comedy horror film Cocaine Bear (2023).
